title: Optimize quant kernels (INT8/FP8) + dequant-fusion paths, KV cache & continuous batching improvements
author: Ava Patel
description: Motivation: reduce token-level latency and tail variance for quantized models (INT8/FP8) by eliminating redundant dequantize paths and improving kernel codegen for fused operations, while preserving numeric fidelity. This PR implements a dequant-fusion optimization that fuses per-head dequantize + matmul into a single kernel for common encoder/decoder attention patterns, optimizes INT8/FP8 GEMM kernels with architecture-specific microkernels, updates KV cache interfaces to expose pre-packed quantized keys for hot prefixes, and improves continuous batching interaction to avoid repeated dequant/quant transitions. The change set includes: 1) new fused dequant+matmul kernel selection and code paths with runtime fallback to standard kernels when unsupported; 2) INT8/FP8 microkernel optimizations (XLA-like tiling and tail handling) and a streamlined layout for faster vectorized loads; 3) a KV cache API addition (kv_cache::get_packed_keys) and an in-memory packed-key cache to avoid repacking on repeated prefixes; 4) scheduler adjustments to continuous batching to coalesce requests that share model variant and quant profile and to skip unnecessary dequantization when using packed keys; 5) comprehensive unit and perf tests including microbenchmarks and an end-to-end regression test against the conversational perf suite. Backwards compatibility: the public inference API is unchanged; internal runtimes fall back automatically. Risk: numeric differences are within accepted tolerances for production models; a small set of model configs may hit fallback path and see reduced improvement. See linked Linear tasks for rollout and canary plan.
commits: Refactor quant kernel dispatcher and add fused dequant_matmul path
Add INT8/FP8 microkernels with architecture selector (AVX2/AVX512/ARMv8)
Expose packed key API on KV cache and add in-memory packed-key cache
Scheduler: continuous batching coalescing by quant_profile + model_variant
Add unit and perf tests + bench harness updates
Docs: runtime release notes and canary instructions
review_comments: Diego Morales: Great work overall. Please add a short explainer on numerical tolerances and a microbenchmark summary in the PR description. Also, consider a more explicit fallback telemetry when the fused kernel isn't selected.
Ava Patel: Added numeric tolerance section to description and added telemetry hooks (runtime.telemetry.quant_fusion_fallback) exposed in kvcache path. Updated bench results in docs.
Priya Nair: Found a race when packed-key cache is evicted during parallel request coalescing; suggested adding a lightweight lock-free check. Added testcase.
Ava Patel: Fixed race by switching to sequence-numbered cache entries and CAS-based install; added unit test that reproduces the eviction window.
Samir Gupta: CI initially failed on macOS/ARM builds due to missing Neon intrinsics fallback; requested an ARM fallback that uses scalar path. Implemented fallback and re-ran CI.
Priya Nair: Approved after requested changes.
Diego Morales: Approved. Left a note to track canary rollout in ENG-2210.

release_notes: Performance: INT8/FP8 quantized inference kernels improved; fused dequant+matmul reduces token latency and p99 for many prefix-heavy workloads. KV cache now supports packed keys to avoid repacking hot prefixes. Scheduler coalescing reduces redundant dequant transitions. See docs/release/2026-02-quant-kernels.md for details and canary instructions.
